title: Winning symbol combination
purpose: One clear reward accent when a winning cluster highlights. Keep the physical symbol texture underneath. Start here: choose the main sound language before individual symbols.
evidence: src/audio.ts: cluster_win does nothing; PixiGameScene.playCombinationAnimation draws links only.

title: Consecutive winning cascade
purpose: Short melodic step for each additional winning cascade; same motif, modest pitch progression, reset each round.
evidence: No cascade-index audio motif in EventAudioBus.route.

title: Tumble refill / settle
purpose: Brief falling-air movement and a soft settled tick as the replacement symbols finish dropping. Avoid a sound for every cell.
evidence: tumble_drop has no audio route; symbol animation details may still play.

title: First Wanted star
purpose: A compact star-lock ping when the first earned star fills. Higher levels already use heat_rise / siren.

title: Dynamite landing
purpose: A dry mechanical landing before the fuse starts.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Burning fuse
purpose: A continuous fizz for the actual arming duration, cancelled at explosion or dismissal.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Each gold-bar ×2
purpose: One short bright accent exactly as each affected value doubles; pitch by reveal order.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Respins replenished / held
purpose: A compact confirmation when the respin meter is held or replenished.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Respin consumed
purpose: A quiet mechanical decrement; distinct from a reward.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Dynamite without a target
purpose: A dry, neutral dud click. No winning flourish.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Getaway spin start
purpose: A short mechanical start cue for the bonus reels.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Getaway column stop
purpose: A restrained click at each bonus column stop; below the gold-bar landing.
evidence: BonusView emits this moment; main.ts onGetawayCue handles only boom.

title: Individual scatter landing
purpose: Optional subtle identity accent, separate from bonus trigger. Existing code deliberately omits per-scatter tease audio; decide whether to restore it.

title: Unavailable action / error
purpose: A quiet neutral error tick, only when an action is rejected. Confirm the exact UI trigger before implementation.
evidence: New design proposal, not a confirmed missing runtime callback.

title: Scatter anticipation
purpose: Rising cue while the anticipation reel is visibly slowing.

title: Anticipation ends without bonus
purpose: Existing descending sting; consider shortening or removing it.

title: Getaway empty spin
purpose: Existing losing-spin cue; assess whether its weight fits the moment.

title: Truck drive-off
purpose: Engine movement as trucks drive away into the bonus.

title: Truck doors
purpose: Latch / door impact as the truck opens.

title: Collection piece movement
purpose: Whoosh during the collection reveal.
